retargetingWorkflows.method: SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with explicit UAL_TO_KAYKIT bone map, computed bind-pose world rotation offsets (R_src^-1 * R_dst), preservePosition=false, and strip '.position' tracks (rotation-only retarget preserves stylized KayKit limb proportions).

SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with UAL_TO_ROCKETBOX map, computed rest-pose localOffsets, strip '.position' tracks, AND restore target bone scales after retargetClip so Bip01's 0.01 parent scale does not leave 100x scale matrices on child bones.

incompatiblePairs.reason: Completely disjoint bone counts (23 vs 65), naming (.l/.r vs UE _l/_r), and rest proportions; requires explicit rotation-only retargeting.
Translation curves in Rig_Large are scaled for larger proportions; keep clips paired to their own Rig_Medium / Rig_Large family unless retargeted.
3ds Max cm Biped (80-81 bones) vs Blender 32-bone IK rig.
Distinct joint counts (62 vs 32) and distinct rig layouts.
